title: Squire: service marketplace
summary: Secure customer and service-provider marketplace with role-based access and real-time updates.
problem: The client needed a secure portal connecting customers with service providers, with strict permissions and real-time tracking.
solution: Built the marketplace backend in NestJS with secure authentication, role-based access control, unit-tested API modules and real-time service-update workflows.
result: Delivered a stable marketplace and reduced production bugs by 45%.
